text:
I checked `voice-bridge/requirements.md` and sent `mastermind-voice-bridge` a rewrite. It has not changed the file yet, and I did not look at any rendered page because this is a proposal with no `page.js`.

`node Server/text-check.mjs` flagged nothing. The title still fails the ten-second test, though. It runs about 25 words with a nested clause.

I sent three changes:
- **Title:** "Voice bridge: talk to a mastermind from the Claude app, fast".
- **Goal line:** one plain line under the title: you speak to the voice agent and hear a mastermind's answer back within seconds, with an ack in under 1 s.
- **Who's who:** turn the bullets into a two-row table so the two systems sit side by side. Also make the agent names in "Do" item 1 links.

I logged one `sent` line in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
